name: io.verifiedwallet/verifiedwallet
title: VerifiedWallet
description: Check crypto addresses before you send: verified owners, company wallets, lookalike scam warnings.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Check a crypto wallet address against the VerifiedWallet register before sending funds to it. Returns a verdict: 'verified' (the owner proved control), 'business' (a verified company's listed wallet), 'warning' (a lookalike of a verified wallet: the address-poisoning scam), 'risk' (verified, but its latest AML screening was flagged) or 'unknown' (nothing on record). Works for Bitcoin, Ethereum and every EVM network, Solana, Tron, XRP, TON, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Cardano, Cosmos, Sui and Aptos; the network is worked out from the address.

address.description: The wallet address to check, exactly as the person intends to send to it.

chain.description: Optional. Only needed when an address could belong to more than one network (0x + 64 hex is Sui or Aptos). One of: evm, bitcoin, solana, tron, xrp, ton, litecoin, dogecoin, bitcoincash, cardano, cosmos, sui, aptos.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Look up a VerifiedWallet certificate by its id (VW-XXXX-XXXX): the wallet, network, tier, what was checked (identity, AML, company) and whether it is revoked. VerifiedWallet's ES256 signature over the certificate is checked against the published key and the result returned as signatureValid. Example certificates are marked sample: true and are not real proof.

tools.name: find_wallet_certificates
tools.description: List every VerifiedWallet certificate issued to a wallet address, including revoked ones, with tier and status. Use check_address instead when the question is whether it's safe to send.

tools.name: get_public_key
tools.description: The public key (ES256 JWK) every VerifiedWallet certificate is signed with, plus retired keys still valid for older certificates. Use it to verify a certificate's attestation independently: the signature covers the canonical JSON of the certificate's core.

tools.name: get_verification_options
tools.description: The verification tiers on sale now, what each checks, its price, and the link where the wallet's owner gets verified. Use it when someone asks how to make their own wallet show as verified. Getting verified needs the owner to sign with their wallet, so it can't be done on their behalf.
